Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer prematurely concluded that the director was Maurice Elvey (British) for “Name the Man” based on the 1923 British film, despite the search results prominently indicating the 1924 American film directed by Victor Sjöström (Swedish). It then repeatedly focused only on Elvey and ignored instructions to verify both films, causing the wrong/ambiguous conclusion about the director’s nationality.
